questions: Should fast arts stay this cheap? First firing equals cooldown, so three 1 s arts at cost 0.08 kill the Flown line at 1.83 s with the rival on 94 %. Their only price is the wall fight.
Is three Hạ phẩm swords in place of a ward kit meant to be this good? The same 180 thần thức takes L3 from 40 to 117.
On the Beat would suit the Flown line, whose cooldowns land on pulses, but its ledger row is Needs rule, so this sheet leaves it out. Does firing on a pulse need a new guard word?
